作戦通り、緊要地形の占領を開始します。\n先行しますので、援護をお願いしますね。: Beginning occupation of the key terrain as planned. I'll take the lead, so please provide backup.
でも、今までのシリウスシュガーだったらいいけど、\nあの指揮官がいるから油断は出: Still, if it were the old Sirius Sugar that'd be one thing, but with that commander around, shouldn't we stay on our toes?
向こうからここに辿り着くにはビル群の隙間を\n最高速度且つ最短距離で駆け抜けてく: For them to reach us from over there, they'd have to barrel through the gaps in these buildings at top speed along the shortest possible route.
そんな馬鹿な芸当をやるにしても、単身が限度。\n試合開始早々に単身突撃をかまして: Even if someone were reckless enough to pull off such a foolish trick, doing it solo is too much. No idiot would pull a solo charge right at the start of the match—
ばっ……！？ 本当に単身で突撃してきた！？\nどんだけ無謀なんですか！？: Wha...!? She actually charged in alone!? Just how reckless can you be!?
障害物だらけの市街地を高速で移動する操縦技術には感心するけど、\n後続がいないん: I'm impressed by her piloting skills, navigating a feature-dense urban zone at high speeds, but without any backup, this is completely meaningless!
沙耶、ユリア！ あの機体を抜かせないでください！\n私達は援護射撃を！: Saya, Julia! Don't let that unit break through! We'll provide covering fire!
大丈夫、大丈夫、大丈夫大丈夫大丈夫です。\n迷うな、一歩踏み出すんです。考える前: It's fine, it's fine, it's fine, it's fine, it's fine. Don't hesitate, take a step forward. Move before you think...!
へぇ、フラットスピンで移動しながらビルを盾にするなんて。\nシリウスシュガーはい: My, using a flat spin to maneuver while using the buildings as cover. I wonder when Sirius Sugar scouted an acrobat.
あんな芸当が出来る人が、シリウスシュガーにいたんですか！？: There was someone in Sirius Sugar who could do a trick like that!?
……多分、あの機体が桃園める……めるちゃんかな？\n指揮官が自信満々に紹介してき: ...That unit is probably Momozono Meru... Meru-chan, right? The timid girl that commander introduced with so much confidence.
あれを捕まえるの面倒くさそうね。\n翻弄されてる内に陣形が崩れたら本末転倒じゃな: Catching that one looks like a pain. Wouldn't it defeat the whole purpose if our formation broke apart while being toyed with?
ふふ、ふふふ……ねえ、私とアニスさんで仕掛けていいですか……！？\nもう我慢でき: Fufu, fufufu... Hey, can Anise-san and I go after her...!? I can't hold back anymore!
ダメです！ 既に私達は出鼻をくじかれています。\n受動的に動いたところで相手の思: No! We've already had our momentum checked. If we react passively, we'll be playing right into their hands...!
敵の想定の上をいかないといけない……そんな考え方。: We have to go beyond the enemy's expectations... That kind of thinking.
そもそも、あの機体は何を考えて単騎で突撃してきたんでしょうか……: In the first place, what on earth was that unit thinking, charging in all by itself...
いえ、そんなの考えるまでもありません……\n答えはずばり、私達の陽動役！: No, there's no need to even think about it... The answer is plain and simple: she's a decoy to distract us!
私達の注意を引き付けて、その隙に他の連中に側面から\n包囲させるつもりってことで: Her goal is to draw our attention, leaving an opening for the rest of them to flank and encircle us! I won't let that happen!
アニス！ 私と共に側面からの接近を警戒してください！\n沙耶、ユリア、フィーは敵: Anise! Stay alert with me for any approach from the flanks! Saya, Julia, Fie, intercept the enemy main force!
陣形を崩した私達に、敵の主力が突っ込んでくるはずです！: With our formation disrupted, the enemy's main force is bound to charge right in!
あの子が陽動だと踏んだのね。: So you're betting that girl is just a diversion.
いいね、採用。ドッグファイトなら私の専売特許だし！！\n沙耶ちゃん、フィーちゃん: Sounds good, approved! Dogfighting is my specialty anyway!! Saya-chan, Fie-chan, let's go—!
……翠蘭の予想通り、レーダーに機体の反応あり。: ...Just as Suiran predicted, there's a unit signal on radar.
面白い作戦だったけど、看破されちゃ意味ないよね～！\nさっさと片づけて……って…: It was an interesting strategy, but it's useless once it's seen through～! Let's wrap this up quickly and... wait, what...?
よぉ。３人で一緒に来てくれるとは手厚い歓迎だな。\nお礼に粗茶でも点ててやろうか: Yo. The three of you coming together is quite the warm welcome. Shall I brew a modest cup of tea in thanks?
主力じゃなくて、指揮官機だけ……！？\nあはは！ おっもしろーい！ やってくれる: It's not their main force, just the commander unit...!? Ahaha! How interesting—! Not bad at all!
……やられましたね。完全にこちらの裏をかかれています。: ...We've been outsmarted. They completely anticipated our response.
あなたのその驚く顔も愛おしいわ。\nでも、驚いているのはあたしも同じよ。: That surprised look on your face is adorable too. Though I must admit, I'm just as surprised as you are.
だって……陽動だと思ったら、\n後ろに残りが全て集まってるとは思わなかったもの。: Because... while I thought that girl was a decoy, I never expected the entire rest of their team to be gathered right behind her.
……木を隠すなら森のなか。機体を隠すなら機体のなか。: ...To hide a tree, use a forest. To hide a unit, use a formation.
この場合、数が逆転してる気がするけどねぇ。\n数が多い方が隠される方というか……: In this case, it feels like the numbers are reversed, though. It's more like the larger group is the one being hidden...
細かいことは後にしようよ！\nあのバカの作戦が上手くいったんだもの、一気に畳みか: Let's save the details for later! That idiot's plan actually worked, so let me press the assault all at once!
しっかし、まさかここまで上手くいくとは……: Still, to think it would go this well...
まず、めるが単騎でカオスメイデンに突っ込む。: First, Meru charges into Chaos Maiden single-handedly.
そして、少し時間をおいて、その後ろを他の連中がついていく。\n作戦は以上だ。: Then, after a brief delay, the rest of you follow right behind her. That's the entire plan.
なるほど……って、それのどこが作戦なんですの！？\nただ無策に突撃してるだけでし: I see... Wait, how is that even a strategy!? That's literally just charging in without a plan, isn't it!?
ただ突撃するだけなら、な。\nめるにはフラットスピンを駆使した陽動をしてもらう。: If it were just a simple charge, sure. But Meru will be using flat spins to stage a flashy diversion.
大袈裟な動きを見せつければ、相手は無視できない。\nそして、あからさまな陽動を前: If she puts on an exaggerated show, the enemy won't be able to ignore her. And faced with such a blatant decoy, they'll naturally suspect a ambush from the flanks.
なるほど。存在しない奇襲を警戒させるわけだ。: I see. You're forcing them to guard against an ambush that doesn't exist.
その通りだ。存在しない側面攻撃という名の虚像を相手に信じ込ませ、\n敵の戦力を分: Exactly. A strategy to trick the enemy into believing in the illusion of a nonexistent flank attack, thereby splitting their forces... I call it: 'Phantom Encirclement'!
最悪、まさかこんなバカな作戦を実行してくるだなんて……！\n作戦でも何でもない、: This is horrible! To think they'd actually execute such a stupid tactic...! That's not a strategy at all, it's just a reckless banzai charge...!
おりゃーっ！ 覚悟しろぉカオスメイデン！\n泣いたって許してなんかやらないんだか: Ooryaa! Prepare yourselves, Chaos Maiden! Even if you cry, I won't forgive you!
